name: Appam
steps: Soak raw rice and boiled rice together for 4 hours.
Grind with grated coconut to smooth batter.
Add yeast dissolved in warm water.
Add a pinch of sugar and salt.
Ferment batter for 8 hours.
Heat appam pan until hot.
Pour a ladle of batter.
Swirl the pan to spread batter on sides.
Cover and cook on medium heat.
Cook until edges turn crisp and center is soft.
Remove and serve hot with stew.

name: Sambar
steps: Pressure cook toor dal until soft.
Extract tamarind juice.
Boil vegetables in tamarind water.
Add sambar powder, turmeric, salt.
Cook until vegetables are tender.
Add mashed dal to the boiling mixture.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Heat coconut oil in a small pan.
Add mustard seeds, let splutter.
Add curry leaves and dry red chillies.
Pour tempering over sambar.
Serve hot with rice.
